info.title: TxGold Business API
info.description: Send and request TxGold payments from your own systems. Every request is signed with your integration key (see TXG1 below and https://docs.txgold.money/authentication). Amounts are decimal strings in TxGold units; errors are application/problem+json.

get.description: One account the signing key may act for. The balance is filled only for the Admin, Manager and Integration roles.

404.description: The account does not exist, or the key is not attached to it.

get.description: Payments in and out of the account, newest first, with each payment's fee, counterparty, USD value and links to its payment request and refund. Balances are filled only for the Admin, Manager and Integration roles.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Earliest time, inclusive: ISO 8601 with Z or an offset (URL-encode a +), or a date (midnight UTC).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Latest time, exclusive. Same format as from.

404.description: The account does not exist, or the key is not attached to it.

get.summary: Find an account by its handle
get.description: Resolves a handle such as @PoolMan to an account id: a business before paying it, or a customer who gave you their handle, so you can store their account id (it stays the same if they rename the handle). Exact match on active accounts only. For a personal account only the id and type come back, and there is no lookup from an id to a handle. At most 60 lookups a minute per key.

parameters.name: accountName
parameters.description: The handle, with or without the leading @.

404.description: No active account has that handle.

429.description: rate_limited: more than 60 lookups in a minute by this key. Retry-After says when to try again.

get.description: What one TxGold is worth in US dollars now, from the gold price TxGold records every half hour.

503.description: rate_unavailable: no gold price has been recorded.

post.description: Asks a customer, named by payerAccountId or payerHandle, to approve a hold: once approved, you may charge them up to amount, once, before the hold ends (holdMinutes). With neither, makes an open hold request: nobody is notified, and whoever opens its holdUrl first can approve it. Nothing is reserved until the customer approves; poll GET /v1/holds/{id}, or take the hold.held webhook. Resending the identical signed request (same TxG-Timestamp) returns the existing hold with 200.

201.description: Pending; a named customer was notified if their phone is registered. An open request carries its holdUrl.

200.description: Already created by an identical earlier request.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: pending, held, captured, released, declined, cancelled or expired.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only holds with this tag, exactly.

400.description: invalid_request: a bad accountId, status, tag, limit or cursor.

404.description: The account does not exist, or the key is not attached to it.

get.description: Poll until status is held, then turn the pump on.

404.description: No such hold, or the key is not attached to the business that asked for it.

post.description: Lets go of a held hold without charging anything: the customer's money is free at once. On a pending request, cancels it: the customer can no longer approve it.

409.description: hold_not_open: already captured, released, declined, cancelled or expired.

post.description: Charges the customer what you used, once: more than 0 and at most the amount held. The rest goes back to them at once, and they get a receipt in the app. Resending the identical signed request returns the same capture with 200.

201.description: Captured: the hold and the payment that charged it.

200.description: Already captured by an identical earlier request.

409.description: hold_not_held (still pending, or already captured, released, declined or cancelled) or hold_expired.

post.description: Asks a TxGold account to pay one of yours, named by payerAccountId or payerHandle. With neither, makes an open request: nobody is notified, and anyone with its paymentUrl can pay it, once. Resending the identical signed request (same TxG-Timestamp) returns the existing request with 200 instead of creating another.

201.description: Created; a named payer was notified if their phone is registered. An open request carries its paymentUrl.

200.description: Already created by an identical earlier request.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: pending, paid, dismissed, cancelled or expired.

400.description: invalid_request: a bad accountId, status, limit or cursor.

404.description: The account does not exist, or the key is not attached to it.
No such request, or the key is not attached to the account that made it.

post.description: Withdraws a pending request: it disappears from the payer's app, and paying it is refused.

409.description: request_not_pending: already paid, dismissed, cancelled or expired.

post.description: Sends TxGold from one of your accounts, optionally paying a payment request addressed to it. Resending the identical signed request (same TxG-Timestamp) returns the original payment with 200 instead of paying twice.

200.description: Already paid by an identical earlier request.

403.description: The key's role may not send.

409.description: duplicate_request (a different payment used this timestamp) or request_not_pending.

422.description: insufficient_balance, daily_send_limit_exceeded, amount_must_match_request, payment_request_not_payable and the other business rules.

get.description: A payment either side of which the signing key may act for.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The side to see it from, for a key attached to both accounts. Default: the paying side if the key is on it.

404.description: No such payment, or not visible to this key.

post.description: Returns all or part of a payment your account received to the account that sent it. A payment can be refunded once. TxGold's fee on the original payment is not returned.

201.description: The refund, a payment whose refundOf is the original.

422.description: refund_exceeds_original, insufficient_balance and the other business rules.

post.summary: Add test TxGold to an account (Sandbox only)
post.description: Pays test TxGold into one of your accounts, or one of its demo customers, from TxGold's Holding account. Not available in production.

404.description: The account does not exist, or is neither yours nor one of your demo customers.

post.summary: Have a demo customer pay a payment request (Sandbox only)
post.description: Pays one of your pending payment requests from the demo customer it was sent to, exactly as the customer would in the TxGold app, so you can test your flow without a phone. An open request is paid by the demo customer in payerAccountId, or your first one. The customer is funded first if short. Not available in production.

201.description: The customer's payment, as your account sees it (a credit).

422.description: payer_not_demo_customer, and the business rules a payment can break.

post.summary: Have a demo customer approve a hold (Sandbox only)
post.description: Approves one of your pending hold requests as the demo customer it was sent to, exactly as the customer would in the TxGold app, so you can test pay-at-the-pump without a phone. An open request is approved by the demo customer in payerAccountId, or your first one. The customer is funded first if short. Not available in production.

422.description: payer_not_demo_customer, and the business rules an approval can break (daily_send_limit_exceeded).

get.description: The demo customers that came with your Sandbox business: the accounts that pay your payment requests and approve your hold requests on demand, since nobody holds a phone for them. Send requests to them, name one as payerAccountId, or fund one. Any key on the account may list them. Not available in production.

404.description: The account does not exist, or the key is not attached to it.

id.description: Account id. A string: do not do arithmetic on it.

accountName.description: The account's handle, without the leading @. Null if it has none.

displayName.description: Name shown to people paying or being paid by this account.

type.description: personal, business or charity. Other values may be added.

tier.description: Verification tier, which sets the account's limits.

active.description: False when the account has been deactivated and cannot send or receive.

balance.description: TxGold balance as a decimal string. Null unless the key's role may see it (Admin, Manager, Integration).

id.description: The account id. For a customer, store it: it stays the same if they rename their handle.

accountName.description: The account's handle, without the leading @.

displayName.description: The name a business or charity is shown by. Null for a personal account.

type.description: personal, business or charity. Other values may be added.

id.description: The payment's id; GET /v1/payments/{id}?accountId= returns it in full.

direction.description: debit when the account paid, credit when it was paid.

fee.description: TxGold's fee on a credit, which the recipient pays. Null on a debit.

memoInternal.description: The payer's own reference. On debits only.

paymentRequestId.description: The payment request this payment paid, if any.

refundOf.description: When this payment is a refund: the payment it refunds.

refundId.description: The refund of this payment, if it has been refunded.

balanceAfter.description: The account's balance after this payment and its fee. Null unless the key's role may see the balance (Admin, Manager, Integration).

estimatedUsdValue.description: What the TxGold was worth in US dollars at the gold price of that moment. Null for payments older than TxGold's price history.

actualUsdValue.description: US dollars that really changed hands, where there were any (a crypto deposit). Null otherwise.

type.description: URI of the documentation page for this error code.

title.description: Short summary of the error code.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, e.g. insufficient_balance. Switch on this, not on detail.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of this occurrence. The wording may change.

requestId.description: The X-Request-Id of the request. Quote it when contacting support.

errors.description: For invalid_request: the problems with each field, keyed by field name.

accountName.description: The account's handle, without the leading @. Null if it has none.

type.description: personal, business or charity. Other values may be added.

counterparty.description: The other side of the payment.

id.description: The hold's id, from request to charge.

status.description: pending (waiting for the customer), held (you may charge it), captured, released, declined (by the customer), cancelled (by you) or expired. Other values may be added.

payerAccountId.description: The customer. For an open hold request, null until someone approves it.

isOpen.description: True for an open hold request: no customer named; whoever opens its holdUrl first can approve it.

amount.description: The amount held, or asked to be held.

holdMinutes.description: How long the hold lasts once approved, in minutes.

approveBy.description: When the request stops being approvable.

heldAt.description: When the customer approved it. Null until then.

heldUntil.description: When the hold ends: charge or release it before then, or it expires and the money is the customer's again. Null until approved.

amountReleased.description: What went back to the customer unused: the rest of the hold once captured, all of it once released.

paymentId.description: The payment that charged it, once captured: GET /v1/payments/{id}.

endedAt.description: When the customer declined it or you cancelled it, or when it was captured or released.

holdUrl.description: An open hold request's link, while it is pending: opens the TxGold app on this request to approve it. Show it as a QR code, or hand the customer off to it from your own app. Null otherwise.

amount.description: What to charge, more than 0 and at most the amount held. The rest is released at once. To charge nothing, release the hold instead.

memo.description: The payment's memo, shown to the customer. Defaults to the hold's memo. At most 150 characters.

accountId.description: Your business account, which may charge the hold once it is approved. The signing key must be attached to it.

payerAccountId.description: The customer asked to approve the hold, by account id (look a handle up once with GET /v1/accounts/lookup, and store the id). They get a push notification. Give this, or payerHandle, or neither for an open hold request that whoever opens its holdUrl first can approve.

payerHandle.description: The customer by TxGold handle, e.g. "Jason-Miles" (a leading @ is ignored), instead of payerAccountId.

amount.description: Amount of TxGold to hold, as a decimal string with at most 2 places: the most you will be able to charge.

memo.description: Shown to the customer when they approve, and becomes the charge's memo. At most 150 characters.

memoInternal.description: Your own reference, never shown to the customer. At most 150 characters.

approveBy.description: When the request stops being approvable, ISO 8601. Default 10 minutes from now, at most 24 hours.

holdMinutes.description: How long the hold lasts once approved, in minutes: you must charge or release it before then. Default 60, from 1 to 4320 (3 days).

tag.description: Your own label, never shown to the customer: a pump, a till, a device. At most 50 characters. GET /v1/holds filters on it.

direction.description: debit when the signing key's account paid, credit when it was paid.

fee.description: TxGold's fee, which the recipient pays. Shown to the recipient only; null for the payer.

memoInternal.description: The payer's own reference. Shown to the payer only.

paymentRequestId.description: The payment request this payment paid, if any.

holdId.description: The hold this payment charged, if any (POST /v1/holds/{id}/capture).

refundOf.description: When this payment is a refund: the payment it refunds.

refundId.description: The refund of this payment, if it has been refunded (at most once).

balanceAfter.description: Only in the response that created the payment: the paying account's balance afterwards, when the key's role may see it.

accountId.description: The account paying. The signing key must be attached to it with a role that may send (Admin, Manager or Integration).

destinationAccountId.description: The account paid. Optional with paymentRequestId, which pays the account that made the request.

amount.description: Amount of TxGold, as a decimal string with at most 2 places. Must equal the request's amount with paymentRequestId.

memo.description: Shown to both sides. At most 150 characters.

memoInternal.description: Your own reference, never shown to the recipient. At most 150 characters.

paymentRequestId.description: Pays this pending payment request, addressed to accountId, and marks it paid.

status.description: pending, paid, dismissed (by the payer), cancelled (by you) or expired. Other values may be added.

payerAccountId.description: The account asked to pay. Null for an open request until it is paid, then the account that paid it. Null when the request named its payer by payerHandle.

isOpen.description: True for an open request: no payer named, payable once by anyone with its paymentUrl.

statusChangedAt.description: When the status last changed (paid, dismissed or cancelled). Null while pending or expired.

paymentId.description: The payment that paid it, once paid.

paymentUrl.description: An open request's link: opens the TxGold app on this request. Share it, or draw it as a QR code. Changing its amount or memo changes nothing: the request's own are what the payer sees and must pay. Null for a request to a named payer.

accountId.description: The business account to be paid. The signing key must be attached to it.

payerAccountId.description: The TxGold account asked to pay. Its owner gets a push notification and sees the request in the app. Give this, or payerHandle, or neither for an open request that anyone with its paymentUrl can pay once.

payerHandle.description: The payer by TxGold handle, e.g. "Jason-Miles" (a leading @ is ignored), instead of payerAccountId: what a customer types at your checkout. Any active account. The payer's account id is not returned.

amount.description: Amount of TxGold, as a decimal string with at most 2 places. The payer must pay exactly this.

memo.description: Shown to the payer, and becomes the payment's memo. At most 150 characters.

memoInternal.description: Your own reference, never shown to the payer. At most 150 characters.

expiresAt.description: When the request stops being payable, ISO 8601. A request to a payer: default and maximum 7 days from now. An open request: default 30 days, maximum 90.

tag.description: Your own label for the request (a till, a device, a campaign), never shown to the payer. At most 50 characters.

usdPerTxGold.description: US dollars per TxGold, to 6 decimal places. One TxGold is a thousandth of a troy ounce of gold.

usdPerTroyOunce.description: The gold price the rate comes from: US dollars per troy ounce.

asOf.description: When that gold price was taken (UTC). Prices are refreshed every half hour.

amount.description: Amount to refund, at most what was paid. Leave out to refund the whole payment.

memo.description: Shown to both sides. At most 150 characters.

memoInternal.description: Your own reference. At most 150 characters.

id.description: The demo customer's account id: use it as payerAccountId, destinationAccountId or the account to fund.

accountName.description: Its handle, without the leading @, e.g. AcmeSandbox-Customer1: usable as payerHandle.

balance.description: Its test TxGold balance. The Sandbox tops a demo customer up when it is short, so this rarely matters.

data.description: Oldest first. The first is the one that pays or approves an open request when you name none.

amount.description: Test TxGold to add, as a decimal string with at most 2 places. At most 1000.00 per call.

payerAccountId.description: For an open request: which of your demo customers pays it. Default: your first demo customer. Ignored for a request to a named payer.

TXG1.description:
Every request carries three headers: TxG-Key-Id (your key's base64 SubjectPublicKeyInfo, the keyId in your key file), TxG-Timestamp (UTC .NET ticks, at most 3 minutes ahead of and 7 minutes behind server time; it is also the request's idempotency key) and TxG-Signature (base64 ECDSA P-256 SHA-256 over the canonical string, P1363 or DER):

    TXG1-ECDSA-P256-SHA256
METHOD
PATH
QUERY
TIMESTAMP
hex(sha256(body bytes))

The SDKs do this for you. See https://docs.txgold.money/authentication.
TXG1.name: TxG-Signature
